description: ADR-0008: the three answers of the host's approval policy for one act call (tool-offer.json#/$defs/approvalPolicy; HostTool.approve in TypeScript, ApprovalPolicy in Go, go/context/sources.go), asked with the call and answered at once. outcomes says what each does: allow, the call runs under the gate's bounds, as an act call ran before the pause; refuse, it is refused at the gate with a guardrail whose reason is approval refused (second-act-while-pending.json shows the other reason, approval pending) and never run; ask, the run pauses with approval_requested and the checkpoint paused (pause.json). An answer that is none of the three, or a policy that fails, is refuse. Written by hand from the schema; tests/test_contract.py holds the outcomes to the items.

outcomes.allow: the call runs under its bounds
outcomes.refuse: refused with the approval refused guardrail, never run
outcomes.ask: the run pauses with approval_requested, the checkpoint paused
